name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
benefit: Pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60 for unorganised workers, with a monthly contribution
verification_note: Seed data written from public knowledge; confirm rules, amounts and URLs on the official source before relying on them.
notes: Occupation is not restricted to daily wage; any unorganised worker in the age band may apply.

rules.text: Age is 40 or below at joining
Monthly income is at or below Rs 15,000
Not covered by EPFO, ESIC or NPS

documents.name: Aadhaar (identity only — do not enter the number in this app)

steps: Check eligibility on the official portal or at a Common Service Centre
Register with Aadhaar and bank details at the Common Service Centre or on the portal
Contribute the monthly amount through auto-debit
Note the registration number and check your contribution status on the portal
